headline.t: and it comes with a catch

paras: On Oct 14, the European Banking Authority classified Circle's EU-issued USDC as a <g>“significant” e-money token</g> under MiCA.
<u>It's the first of 45 e-money tokens notified in the EU to get that label.</u>
Not a new licence. Not a penalty. Just a <g>much bigger regulator watching.</g>

items.l: of stablecoin transaction volume in Q1

paras: From <g>Nov 12</g>, the EBA takes direct control of USDC's:

→ Own funds
→ Reserve assets
→ Liquidity
→ Recovery & redemption plans
France's ACPR, which licensed Circle in 2024, keeps governance and fit-and-proper checks.
<r>Get big enough, and the EU's top banking watchdog moves in.</r>
The label is reviewed every year, and covers USDC only, not Circle's euro coin EURC.
